data.fastener: M14 x 1.50, cone type; 22 mm socket
data.notes: Printed: 130 ft-lb (176 N·m). Use a calibrated torque wrench and a six-sided deep-wall socket. Tighten in a star pattern until each nut has been tightened twice. Don't oil the studs; clean off dirt/oil and corrosion on the wheel mounting surface first. Recheck torque after 25 miles (40 km). Don't fully tighten until the truck is lowered off the jack (p. 394).

data.fluid_spec: Mopar API Certified SAE 0W-40 Full Synthetic Engine Oil meeting Material Standard MS-A0921 (or equivalent full-synthetic 0W-40 with the API Donut mark)
data.condition: With filter, after draining the oil cooler

Oil drains from two places: the oil pan drain bolt and the oil cooler drain bolt; the TRX dune guard must come off to reach the filter and cooler drain (p. 346).

data.name: Maximum oil change interval
data.text: 10,000 miles (16,000 km), 12 months or 350 hours of engine run time, whichever comes first
data.notes: Change sooner when the oil change indicator says so; service within 500 miles (805 km) of the message.

data.name: Maximum oil change interval
data.text: 6,000 miles (10,000 km) or six months, whichever comes first
data.notes: Severe duty (dusty/off-road, mostly idle or very low RPM): every 4,000 miles (6,500 km) or 350 hours of engine run time. Change at six months even if the indicator hasn't come on.
